text:
PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: P1 page fired to service=platform-prod, urgency=high, incident=INC-98765 — high 5xx rate on /v1/generate (more than 150 errors/min)

incident-bot: created thread for INC-98765 — page routed to platform-prod

Devon: acked. I'm on it. :wave:

Priya: Devon — are you seeing alerts in the inference dashboard? I just got notified by a customer that generation is failing for them.

Devon: opening logs now. grabbing pd details: `pdcli incidents show INC-98765 --service platform-prod` — looks like the trigger came from alarms in prometheus-rule `prod-5xx-spike`

Ben: heads-up: I think this was routed to the wrong PagerDuty service. I see a recent schedule override that added contractors to the platform-prod rota for nights.

Devon: hmm, confirm — the page is hitting the 'platform-prod' service but our inference team is on `prod-inference` service. platform-prod is a legacy umbrella that shouldn't be paging SRE.

Priya: Can someone check the schedule tags? `pdcli schedules list --filter night-override` ?

Sam (SRE): running that now — `pdcli schedules list --query "name:night-ops-override"` returns schedule `night-ops-override` attached to service `platform-prod` as of 2026-03-14T02:00Z by deploy-bot.

Devon: That explains it. Looks like a deploy-time temporary override got applied and not removed.

Ben: I'm going to temporarily suppress routing to platform-prod while we fix. Doing: `pdcli services update platform-prod --auto_resolve_timeout 300 --escalation_policy null` (will re-route alerts) — will post when done.

Oncall Rotation Bot: Note: muting a service will still create incidents if rules fire. Consider updating the alert rule targets.

Ben: updated. I changed the alert target to route to `prod-inference` service instead. `pdcli rules replace --service platform-prod --target prod-inference` — new page will go to correct team.

Priya: thanks. Devon, can you confirm we stopped noisy pages? any more 5xxs?

Devon: 5xx rate dropped after the temporary throttling (we restarted the canary). Errors still present for a subset of traffic. Running `kubectl logs -l app=inference -c model` — seeing model OOMs on a node.

Sam (SRE): OOMs could be from a model rollout earlier today. Rolling back the rollout to stable v1.2.1 now. `kubectl rollout undo deployment/inference-model --to-revision=3` — started.

Devon: rollback in progress. Canary pods terminating.

PagerDuty Bot: incident INC-98765 assigned to prod-inference after routing update; Devon is primary.

Priya: customer impact — initial report from two customers (acme-corp, beta-user-group) with partial failures for ~15 minutes. API success rate ~85% during the spike. We'll classify as degraded with partial customer impact.

Devon: confirmed. Affected endpoints: /v1/generate (primarily long-sequence requests). Short sequences mostly fine.

Ben: mitigation checklist:
- reroute alerts -> done
- rollback model rollout -> in progress
- remove schedule override -> pending (I will remove once we confirm)
- notify contractors about accidental add -> PR raised to revoke temporary membership

Priya: timeline for rollback completion?

Sam (SRE): rollout undo finished at +00:03:40. Metrics show error rate returning to baseline over last 60s.

Devon: baseline restored. No further 5xxs in 2m sampling window. I'm going to close the incident after monitoring for 10 more minutes.

Ben: removed schedule override: `pdcli schedules remove-user night-ops-override user:contractor-x` and updated the deploy-bot config so future deploys don't reapply. Also adding a CI check to disallow schedule attachments to platform-prod.

Priya: good. Please add a short incident summary for customers and ops.

Devon: draft summary:
- root cause: temporary schedule override attached contractors and an incorrect alert target after a deploy; alert routing sent P1 to platform-prod which paged the wrong on-call group. Concurrent model rollout caused OOMs for long requests.
- impact: partial degradation of /v1/generate; two known customer groups experienced failed requests for ~15 minutes.
- mitigation: corrected alert routing to prod-inference, rolled back model rollout, removed override, added guardrail on deploys.
- next steps: postmortem, add CI guardrail, update runbook for schedule override checks, notify affected customers.

Priya: looks good. Add timestamped actions and owners.

Devon: added owners in the runbook draft. I'll mark incident resolved in PD: `pdcli incidents resolve INC-98765` — resolving now.

PagerDuty Bot: INC-98765 resolved by Devon at 2026-03-15T08:04:50Z

Priya: thanks everyone. Quick retro: we should ensure deploy-bot doesn't attach schedules to legacy umbrella services. Sam, can you make a one-liner check in deploy pipeline?

Sam (SRE): will add pre-deploy validation to catch schedule attachments to services in the legacy list. Filing task in infra backlog: INFRA-3421.

Ben: I'll follow up on the CI guardrail and notify Security about contractor permission drift.

Devon: monitoring for 10 more minutes then will close thread. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

(Reaction notes: many :eyes: and :thumbsup: on key posts)

Post-incident tasks:
- INFRA-3421: pre-deploy schedule validation (owner: Sam)
- OPS-2026: add CI check to block schedule attachments to platform-prod (owner: Ben)
- PM-Notify: customer communication draft (owner: Priya)
- PM: runbook update to include schedule override verification (owner: Devon)

Last check-in: no new errors in 10m window. Closing thread in 5.
